footnote_text: Represents shares acquired upon the exercise of a stock option granted on November 14, 2016 covering 200,000 shares of the Issuer's common stock at an exercise price of $7.55 per share. The option was scheduled to expire on November 14, 2026. The Reporting Person exercised the option because of its impending expiration, during an open trading window, and did not receive any cash proceeds from the exercise. The net result of the exercise was an increase of 8,697 shares in the Reporting Person's holdings of the Issuer's common stock.

Represents shares withheld by the Issuer in a net exercise of the option, consisting of 186,651 shares withheld to pay the exercise price of the option and 4,652 shares withheld to satisfy the mandatory tax withholding requirements upon exercise of the option, in each case valued at the closing price of the Issuer's common stock on the transaction date. No shares were sold in the open market. This is not an open market sale of securities. || Represents common stock remaining after deducting the common stock withheld for the exercise price and taxes.
